findings.summary: No declaration was found stating that the Proposition C.2 profiles satisfy all conclusions of Theorem 4.6. exists_weighted_profile bundles (iii)-(iv) only; the other clauses are separate lemmas, in six files, about the same witness.

Clause (iii)'s three named lower bounds, and the single kappa in (0,2) of (4.26), are stated in those words by no declaration found. The repository does perform the compactness step for this witness and states its uniform consequences in its own parameters.

The two edge direction identities of clause (iii) are stated by no declaration about the modulated stress: the collar lemmas hide the edge coefficient behind an existential and export only positivity of its first component and the margins.

Clause (iii) asks the unit direction to extend smoothly to the closed annulus; the assembled closed-annulus statement gives only ContinuousOn. The smooth collar extensions exist but are not glued into a smooth closed-annulus direction.

Lean writes (4.26) additively in unnormalised tilt coordinates, epsilon <= 1+st and epsilon <= 2(1+st)^2-(v-2)(t-s)^2, where the paper writes a multiplicative margin 2-kappa on the unit direction. The same condition once the tilt is bounded.

Clause (i)'s η-analyticity is stated for these profiles, but in the repository's other encoding: holomorphy of the slow hierarchy's axis functions in the complex parameter, reached through the entrance scheme's identification of the base fields.
